description: Defines the CalendarDashlet class for SuiteCRM, including constructor, display, options, and script methods, and manages calendar display within the dashboard.

classes.name: CalendarDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying calendar views in SuiteCRM, extending Dashlet, with configurable view options and display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language, sets title and view, and creates a seed Calendar bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the calendar dashlet, including loading calendar modules, checking access, and displaying calendar activities.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configuration options for the dashlet, including title and view settings.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-selected options such as title and view.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for script inclusion.
